projects.title: Ludicly
projects.description: Ludicly is an education app where you can study for your tests through games. The thing that makes it stand out is that you can make sets(lists of questions) by just uploading a picture of your notes or uploading files like PDFs and then you get a custom set made by AI, the set can later be studied through one of our games or a traditional method like for example flashcards.

projects.title: Atlas
projects.description: Atlas is a workstation I built for myself. It has an AI assistant named "Cosmo" which gets activated with a voice command. The home screen is fully customisable with a bunch of widgets. The thing that makes Atlas unique is that it has a Space screen where you can see all of your files in space as stars you can click on and perform quick actions with.

about: I started programming when I was 8 years old, and I have been building things ever since.
It began with Roblox Studio, where I made my own games using Luau (Roblox's programming language) and learned Blender to build the 3D models for them.
Then I learned C# and Java to make simple terminal apps like calculators, quizzes and other small projects to learn both programming languages.
After I learned Java and C#, I tried Unity 3D since I already knew C# and made games using Unreal Engine shortly after.
Currently I don't make games anymore. I build apps, websites and software with Flutter, React and React Native.
Lately I have been getting into business (especially SaaS) and it has been going pretty well so far.
